The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Thursday, September 25, 2025 - 05:00 PM

This meeting was originally scheduled to take place on Wednesday 24 September 2025, however was rescheduled following the outcomes of the Ordinary Council Meeting held 27 August 2025.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

Ordinary Council Meeting (26 February 2025)

Wednesday, February 26, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

Agenda Briefing Session: Wednesday 19 February 2025 at 5:00pm

Visit our YouTube channel

Confirmed OCM Minutes - (26 February 2025) (2.89 MB)

OCM Agenda - (26 February 2025) (2.38 MB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting (12 November 2025)

Wednesday, November 12, 2025 - 05:00 PM - 06:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The Purpose of this meeting is for Council to:

  • Declare the 2026 Extraordinary Election, including setting the date, voting method and Returning Officer.
  • Endorses the proposed Chief Executive Officer Key Performance Criteria (KPI’s) 2025/2026; and
  • Approve Additional Purpose Expenditure – Organisation Restructure (Confidential).

Agenda

Agenda - Special Council Meeting (364.91 KB)

Minutes

Confirmed SCM Minutes - 12 November 2025 (381.42 KB)

Attachments

Attachments - 12 November 2025 (551.09 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

SCM Agenda - 13 August 2025 (273.82 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Ordinary Council Meeting (27 November 2024)

Wednesday, November 27, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

Agenda Briefing Session: Wednesday 20 November 2024 at 5:00pm

Visit our YouTube channel

Meeting Agenda

OCM Agenda - (27 November 2024) (3.87 MB)

Meeting Minutes

Confirmed OCM Minutes - (27 November 2024) (4.61 MB)

Agenda

ABS Agenda - (20 November 2024) (4.33 MB)

Attachments

OCM Attachments - (27 November 2024) (72.96 MB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Contact the Shire

Office Hours Monday - Friday: 8.30am - 4.00pm

shire@donnybrook.wa.gov.au

(08) 9780 4200

You can also use our number for urgent  after-hours calls.

Address

1 Bentley Street, Donnybrook WA 6239

Ordinary Council Meeting (23 October 2024)

Wednesday, October 23, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

Agenda Briefing Session: Wednesday 16 October 2024 at 5:00pm

Visit our YouTube channel

Please note that due to unforeseen circumstances, the livestream of the Agenda Briefing Session is unavailable to view. We are uncertain as to what has caused this issue, as at the time of the Briefing the the livestream was available to view and working with no errors. The settings have been reviewed and we will continue to monitor these adjustments in the effort to ensure that future livestreams do not have the same outcomes - thank you for your understanding.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

Special Council Meeting (15 May 2024)

Wednesday, May 15, 2024 - 07:15 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The purpose of this Special Council Meeting is for Council to:

  • Consider the recommendations of the Chief Executive Officer and Performance Review Committee concerning the appointment of a person to the position of independent person for the CEO Recruitment Selection Panel as a result of Mr Bruce Hearman withdrawing from the role.

 

Please note that this Special Council Meeting was not livestreamed as the only item for consideration is of a confidential nature, and was therefore held behind closed doors.

Meeting Minutes

SCM Minutes (15 May 2024) - Confirmed (255.70 KB)

Agenda

SCM Agenda (15 May 2024) (229.77 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting (27 March 2024)

Wednesday, March 27, 2024 - 07:45 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The purpose of this Special Council Meeting is for Council to:

  1. Receive the Minutes from the Chief Executive Officer Recruitment and Performance Review Committee held 28 February 2024; and
  2. Award RFQ231 - CEO Recruitment Consultancy Services.

Visit our YouTube channel

Agenda

SCM Agenda (27 March 2024) (281.74 KB)

Minutes

SCM Minutes (27 March 2024) - confirmed (304.99 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting (24 January 2024)

Wednesday, January 24, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The purpose of this Special Council Meeting is for Council to: 

  1. Confirm minutes for Ordinary Council meeting held 13 December 2023.
  2. Receive minutes of the Audit and Risk Management Committee meeting held 20 December 2023.
  3. Presentation of Summary of Accounts for December 2023.
  4. Presentation of Monthly Financial Statements for December 2023.
  5. Annual Financial Statements and Audit Opinion 2022/2023.
  6. Office of the Auditor General Financial Audit Results Local Government 2021/2022.
  7. 2022/2023 Annual Report.
  8. Schedule the Annual General Meeting of Electors 2024.
  9. Appointment of Independent Members to the Audit and Risk Management Committee.

Visit our YouTube Channel

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Ordinary Council Meeting (19 October 2023)

Thursday, October 19, 2023 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

Agenda

OCM Agenda (19 October 2023) (369.48 KB)

Minutes

OCM Minutes (19 October 2023) - confirmed (403.02 KB)

Attachments

OCM Attachments (19 October 2023) (3.91 MB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Wednesday, May 24, 2023 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

Agenda

OCM Agenda (24 May 2023) (777.74 KB)

Minutes

OCM Minutes (24 May 2023) - confirmed (886.98 KB)

Attachments

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting (12 June 2023)

Monday, June 12, 2023 - 10:00 AM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The purpose of this Special Council Meeting is for Council to consider:

  • Presentation of the VC Mitchell Park Project, proposing to move from Hold Point 2 to Hold Point 3.

Agenda

SCM Agenda (12 June 2023) (388.08 KB)

Minutes

SCM Minutes (12 June 2023) - confirmed (429.31 KB)

Attachments

VC Mitchell Park Project Design Development Report (17.26 MB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting (25 January 2023)

Wednesday, January 25, 2023 - 03:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers (1 Bentley St, Donnybrook)

The purpose of this Special Council Meeting is for Council to:

  • Confirm minutes for meetings held in November 2002 and January 2023.
  • Receive and endorse the minutes for the Local Emergency Management Committee Meeting.
  • Presentation of Summary of Accounts and Monthly Financial Statements for November and December 2022.
  • Annual Financial Statements and Audit Opinion 2021/22.
  • 2021-2022 Annual Report.
  • Annual General Meeting of Electors.
  • RFT 01/2223 Southampton Road - Balingup – Road and Path upgrade (CONFIDENTIAL).
  • SHERP – Minninup Cottages delegated Tender Award (CONFIDENTIAL).

Minutes

SCM Minutes (25 January 2023) - confirmed (637.51 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Wednesday, July 27, 2022 - 05:00 PM

Please note due to the length of the meeting, the recording has been divided into three parts.

Agenda Ordinary Council Meeting - July 2022 (477.91 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

November 2022 Special Council Meeting

Wednesday, November 16, 2022 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chamber

Purpose: for Council to consider contract documentation for the VC Mitchell Park Project (CONFIDENTIAL ITEM)

Agenda

SCM Agenda (16 November 2022) (286.54 KB)

Minutes

SCM Minutes (16 November 2022) - confirmed (878.59 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

December 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, December 15, 2021 - 12:00 PM

Council Meetings - Wednesday 15 December 2021, 5:00pm, Council Chamber.

Council Meetings are open to the public to attend.

Public Question Time

If you wish to ask a question, you can do so during Public Question Time at the start of the meeting. Each member of the public with a question is entitled to ask up to 2 questions and shall have two minutes to submit each question. If a question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Members of the public shall have two minutes to submit a question.

Deputations

A person or group that wishes to make a deputation to Council is to apply to the Chief Executive Officer in writing prior to the meeting for approval, or request the Presiding Member’s approval at the meeting. Deputations are not to exceed five persons, only 2 of whom may address the Council, although others may respond to specific questions from Members. The deputation is not to exceed 10 minutes without the agreement of the Council.

October 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, October 27, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Council Meetings - Wednesday 27 October 2021, 5:00pm, Council Chamber.

Council Meetings are open to the public to attend.

Public Question Time

If you wish to ask a question, you can do so during Public Question Time at the start of the meeting. Each member of the public with a question is entitled to ask up to 2 questions and shall have two minutes to submit each question. If a question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Members of the public shall have two minutes to submit a question.

Deputations

A person or group that wishes to make a deputation to Council is to apply to the Chief Executive Officer in writing prior to the meeting for approval, or request the Presiding Member’s approval at the meeting. Deputations are not to exceed five persons, only 2 of whom may address the Council, although others may respond to specific questions from Members. The deputation is not to exceed 10 minutes without the agreement of the Council.

August 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, August 25, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Council Meetings - Wednesday 25 August 2021, 5:00pm, Council Chamber.

Council Meetings are open to the public to attend.

Public Question Time

If you wish to ask a question, you can do so during Public Question Time at the start of the meeting. Each member of the public with a question is entitled to ask up to 2 questions and shall have two minutes to submit each question. If a question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Members of the public shall have two minutes to submit a question.

Deputations

A person or group that wishes to make a deputation to Council is to apply to the Chief Executive Officer in writing prior to the meeting for approval, or request the Presiding Member’s approval at the meeting. Deputations are not to exceed five persons, only 2 of whom may address the Council, although others may respond to specific questions from Members. The deputation is not to exceed 10 minutes without the agreement of the Council.

May 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, May 26, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Council Meetings - Wednesday 26 May 2021, 5:00pm, Council Chamber.

Council Meetings are open to the public to attend.

Public Question Time

If you wish to ask a question, you can do so during Public Question Time at the start of the meeting. Each member of the public with a question is entitled to ask up to 2 questions and shall have two minutes to submit each question. If a question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Members of the public shall have two minutes to submit a question.

Deputations

A person or group that wishes to make a deputation to Council is to apply to the Chief Executive Officer in writing prior to the meeting for approval, or request the Presiding Member’s approval at the meeting. Deputations are not to exceed five persons, only 2 of whom may address the Council, although others may respond to specific questions from Members. The deputation is not to exceed 10 minutes without the agreement of the Council.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

March 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting

Wednesday, March 24, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Council Meeting - Wednesday 24 March 2021, 5:00pm, Council Chamber

Council Meetings are open to the public to attend.

Public Question Time

If you wish to ask a question, you can do so during Public Question Time at the start of the meeting. Each member of the public with a question is entitled to ask up to 2 questions and shall have two minutes to submit each question. If a question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Members of the public shall have two minutes to submit a question.

Deputations

A person or group that wishes to make a deputation to Council is to apply to the Chief Executive Officer in writing prior to the meeting for approval, or request the Presiding Member’s approval at the meeting. Deputations are not to exceed five persons, only 2 of whom may address the Council, although others may respond to specific questions from Members. The deputation is not to exceed 10 minutes without the agreement of the Council.

Tuesday, October 19, 2021 - 06:00 PM

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup

NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

 

Tuesday 19 October, commencing at 6pm.

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber

Collins Street, Donnybrook

 

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup advises that a Special Council Meeting will be held in the Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber on Tuesday 19 October commencing at 6.00pm.

The purpose of the Special Council Meeting will be:

  1. Swearing in of New Councillors and Election of the Shire President and Deputy Shire President              

The Special Meeting Agenda is available on the Shire website.

 

Benjamin (Ben) Rose

Chief Executive Officer

Wednesday, June 16, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Agenda

Special Council Meeting Agenda - 16 June 2021 (284.21 KB)

Minutes

Confirmed Minutes Special Council Meeting - 16 June 2021 (491.47 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING 2 JUNE 2021

Wednesday, June 2, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup

NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

 

Wednesday 2 June 2021, commencing at 5pm.

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber

Collins Street, Donnybrook

 

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup advises that a Special Council Meeting will be held in the Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber on Wednesday 2 June commencing at 5.00pm.

 

The purpose of the Special Council Meeting will be to consider:

 

  1. Leasing of 30 Allnut Street, Donnybrook (Tuia Lodge – Residential Aged Care Facility) – CONFIDENTIAL ITEM

 

Please note, whilst the agenda item is required to be addressed by the Council as a confidential matter due to the commercial-in-confidence nature, members of the public are encouraged to attend the meeting to ask questions and/or make a deputation on the matter.

 

 

Benjamin (Ben) Rose

Chief Executive Officer

SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING 19 MAY 2021

Wednesday, May 19, 2021 - 05:00 PM

NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

 

Wednesday 19 May 2021, commencing at 5pm.

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber

Collins Street, Donnybrook

 

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup advises that a Special Council Meeting will be held in the Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber on Wednesday 19 May 2021 commencing at 5.00pm.

 

The purpose of the Special Council Meeting will be to consider:

 

  1. Proposed Lease of Lot 597 Collins Street, Donnybrook (Donnybrook Goods Shed)

– CONFIDENTIAL ITEM

 

  1. Proposed Lease of 30 Allnut Street, Donnybrook (Tuia Lodge – Residential Aged Care Facility) – CONFIDENTIAL ITEM

 

Please note, whilst the agenda items are required to be addressed by the Council as confidential matters due to their commercial-in-confidence nature, members of the public are encouraged to attend the meeting to ask questions and/or make a deputation on either of the matters.

 

Benjamin (Ben) Rose

Chief Executive Officer

2021 Annual General Meeting of Electors

Wednesday, January 20, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup

ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF ELECTORS

 

Wednesday 20 January 2021, commencing at 5pm.

Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber

Collins Street, Donnybrook

 

The Annual General Meeting of Electors will be held at the Council Chamber, Collins Street, Donnybrook on Wednesday 20 January 2021, commencing at 5pm.

Copies of the Annual Report for the year ended 30 June 2020 are available to the public from the Shire Administration Office during normal office hours, or viewed on the Shire website at www.donnybrook-balingup.wa.gov.au.

 

Benjamin (Ben) Rose

Chief Executive Officer

Agenda

Agenda Annual General Meeting of Electors - 20 January 2021 (330.73 KB)

Minutes

Minutes Annual General Meeting of Electors - 20 January 2021 (305.29 KB)

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Office Hours Monday - Friday: 8.30am - 4.00pm

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

May Council Meeting 2020

Wednesday, May 27, 2020 - 05:00 PM

Click here to view the Ordinary Council Meeting online, from 5pm. 

COVID-19 Council Meeting Guidelines for the Public

Due to recent advice from the WA Government on easing restrictions and allowing 20 person gatherings (subject to social distancing requirements), the Shire of Donnybrook Balingup will resume in-person Council Meetings in the Council Chamber.

Public Attendance

Social distancing requirements currently allow for no more than 20 persons to be present in the Council Chamber. Nine Elected Members, plus four staff members allows for a maximum of seven members of the public to attend the meetings in-person. As the Local Government Act 995 entitles the public to observe meetings, the Shire will be making a video link available on its website to enable members of the public not present to view the meeting from an alternative location. Members of the public will be permitted to enter the Chamber on a first come basis until the maximum limit of 20 persons is reached.

The existing schedule of Agenda Briefing Meetings and Council Meetings will continue, with limits being placed on the number of members of public able to attend in-person. A video link will be available on the Shire’s website for members of the public wishing to view the meetings.

Public Question Time

 Members of the public are requested to submit any questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer via email shire@donnybrook.wa.gov.au by 3pm on the day of the Council Meeting. If the question is unable to be answered at the meeting, it may be taken on notice by the Council for a later response. Questions and answers will be printed in the Minutes.

 

Deputations

 Members of the public are requested to submit a request for deputation in relation to an item on the agenda to the Chief Executive Officer via email shire@donnybrook.wa.gov.au by 12pm on the day of the Council Meeting. A staff member will contact you to confirm the process for you to attend the meeting and deliver your deputation.

 

Agenda Briefings

There is no opportunity for public questions or deputations at Agenda Briefing Sessions, although members of the public are welcome to attend and observe the meeting.

 

Confidential Items

 For any confidential items that require the meeting to be closed to the public, members of the public attending in-person will be asked to leave the Chamber, and members of the public viewing the meeting via video link will be disconnected. Following the re-opening of the meeting, the video link will be re-connected and members of the public will be permitted to return to the Chamber.

 

Minutes

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting - 14 April 2020

Tuesday, April 14, 2020 - 05:00 PM

A Special Council Meeting is being held at 5.00pm on Tuesday 14 April 2020 for Council to consider the Shire's COVID-19 Recovery Plan.   

eMeeting Procedures

The Local Government (Administration) Regulations have been amended to allow eMeetings to be held during the COVID-19 pandemic situation and in accordance with Government guidelines.

Members of the public are advised that public questions need to be received by 3pm the day of the meeting. Under the amended Local Government (Administration) Regulations, Council can determine at the meeting whether to respond to the question at the meeting, or to take the question on  notice and respond at a later date.

In accordance with Regulation 14E(b), the unconfirmed minutes of the meeting will be available for public inspection following the meeting.

Annual General Meeting of Electors 2020

Monday, March 16, 2020 - 05:30 PM

Annual General Meeting of Electors

Members of the public are invited to attend the Annual General Meeting of Electors of the Shire of Donnybrook Balingup.

When: Monday 16 March 2020 commencing at 5.30pm.

Where: Shire of Donnybrook Balingup Council Chamber, Collins Street, Donnybrook.

The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the 2018/19 Annual Report and any general business of electors of the district.

Copies of the 2018/2019 Annual Report are available via the Shire’s website, or for viewing at the Shire Office or Shire Libraries (Donnybrook and Balingup).

 

Benjamin (Ben) Rose
Chief Executive Officer

The Shire of Donnybrook Balingup acknowledges the continuing connection of Aboriginal people to Country, culture and community.

We recognise the Traditional Owners of this land, the Wardandi and Ganeang/Kaneang people of the Noongar Nation, and pay our respects to Elders past and present.
